# Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024 DALY Comparison

## Overview
This collection of datasets captures the global epidemiological transition between 1990 and 2024, covering top causes of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), disease burden composition by World Bank income group, and aggregate category totals.

## Data Source

### top10_daly_causes
Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.

### daly_by_income_group
Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.

### global_category_totals
Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

python - <<'PY'
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

data=json.loads(Path('benchmark/source_data.json').read_text())
rows=data['daly_by_income_group']['data']

order_income=['Low income','Lower-middle income','Upper-middle income','High income']
years=[1990,2024]

# Colors (colorblind-ish): Communicable=blue, NCD=orange, Injury=gray
COLORS={'Communicable':(30,136,229), 'NCD':(245,124,0), 'Injury':(120,144,156)}

# Layout
W,H=1600,900
margin_l, margin_r, margin_t, margin_b = 140, 60, 110, 140
panel_gap=80
panel_w=(W - margin_l - margin_r - panel_gap)//2
panel_h=H - margin_t - margin_b

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
font=ImageFont.load_default()
font_b=ImageFont.load_default()

# helper for text

def text_size(txt, f=font):
    bbox=d.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    return bbox[2]-bbox[0], bbox[3]-bbox[1]

# Title
TITLE='Disease burden composition by income group — 1990 vs 2024'
sub='Share of total DALYs by broad category (percent)'

tw,th=text_size(TITLE,font_b)
d.text(((W-tw)/2, 30), TITLE, fill=(0,0,0), font=font_b)
tw2,th2=text_size(sub,font)
d.text(((W-tw2)/2, 55), sub, fill=(60,60,60), font=font)

# panel origins
x0=margin_l
x1=margin_l+panel_w+panel_gap
y0=margin_t

# row geometry
n=len(order_income)
row_gap=20
row_h=(panel_h - row_gap*(n-1))//n
bar_h=row_h*0.55

# Axis label left
d.text((20, (margin_t+H-margin_b)/2), 'Income group', fill=(0,0,0), font=font)

# x axis label bottom
xlabel='Share of total DALYs (%)'
twx,thx=text_size(xlabel,font)
d.text(((W-twx)/2, H-margin_b+70), xlabel, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)

# draw panels
for yi,year in enumerate(years):
    px = x0 if year==1990 else x1
    # panel title
    pt=f'{year}'
    twp,thp=text_size(pt,font_b)
    d.text((px + (panel_w-twp)/2, margin_t-45), pt, fill=(0,0,0), font=font_b)

    # vertical gridlines at 0,25,50,75,100
    for g in [0,25,50,75,100]:
        gx = px + int(panel_w * (g/100))
        d.line([(gx, y0-5),(gx, y0+panel_h+5)], fill=(235,235,235), width=1)
        if year==2024: # label only on right to avoid clutter? actually label both top? We'll label bottom ticks once
            pass
    # x axis baseline
    d.line([(px, y0+panel_h),(px+panel_w, y0+panel_h)], fill=(0,0,0), width=1)

    for i,inc in enumerate(order_income):
        r=next(x for x in rows if x['year']==year and x['income_group']==inc)
        cy = y0 + i*(row_h+row_gap)
        by = cy + (row_h-bar_h)/2

        # income labels only once (left of first panel)
        if year==1990:
            d.text((margin_l-10-text_size(inc,font)[0], cy + (row_h-text_size(inc,font)[1])/2), inc, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)

        # stacked segments
        segs=[('Communicable', r['communicable_pct']), ('NCD', r['ncd_pct']), ('Injury', r['injury_pct'])]
        cx=px
        for cat,val in segs:
            sw=int(panel_w*(val/100))
            d.rectangle([cx, by, cx+sw, by+bar_h], fill=COLORS[cat], outline=None)
            cx += sw
        # outline full bar
        d.rectangle([px, by, px+panel_w, by+bar_h], outline=(0,0,0), width=1)
        # label dominant share on bar end maybe: show communicable and ncd? We'll show 3 numbers right of bar
        label=f"{r['communicable_pct']:.1f} / {r['ncd_pct']:.1f} / {r['injury_pct']:.1f}"
        # keep within panel: put at right edge slightly outside? We'll put inside near end with dark text on white not possible. Put below bar.
        d.text((px, by+bar_h+4), label, fill=(90,90,90), font=font)

# Tick labels at bottom for both panels
for year,px in [(1990,x0),(2024,x1)]:
    for g in [0,25,50,75,100]:
        gx = px + int(panel_w*(g/100))
        txt=str(g)
        tw,th=text_size(txt,font)
        d.text((gx-tw/2, y0+panel_h+8), txt, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)

# Legend
legend_y=H-margin_b+20
legend_x=margin_l
legend_items=[('Communicable (incl. maternal/neonatal/nutritional)', 'Communicable'), ('Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)','NCD'), ('Injuries','Injury')]
box=18
x=legend_x
for label,cat in legend_items:
    d.rectangle([x, legend_y, x+box, legend_y+box], fill=COLORS[cat], outline=(0,0,0), width=1)
    d.text((x+box+8, legend_y-1), label, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)
    x += box+8+text_size(label,font)[0]+30

# Footnote
foot='Source: modeled GBD-style estimates in benchmark/source_data.json. Values are % of total DALYs within income group; may not sum to 100% due to rounding.'
d.text((margin_l, H-45), foot, fill=(90,90,90), font=font)

out=Path('output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
img.save(out)
print('saved',out,'size',img.size)
PY
